items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: I just played with Dan Moody from Bugalusi... We used to go on the road.

ctx.x: And well I done played with every band in town. I just played with Dan Moody from Bugalusi. Oh yeah. He died. Big Dan, yeah. He had a wonderful band. We used to go on the road. all on the coast, Mississippi, Louisiana, all around. I remember one night we was playing in Hazelwood, Mississippi. Cold, cold one night. So after we played the dance we'd come to, we were still in the hall, so we made a big fire. So we couldn't get, didn't want to go awake, nobody had to get a room you know. So we decided we'd take the…
Yeah, that'd be painful, that'd be hurt and soft.
